name: sylo-allen-bradley
description: Studio 5000 Logix Designer SDK wrapper — harness-neutral MCP server (Claude Code, Codex, pi via pi-mcp-adapter): controller upload/download and ACD↔L5X export/import. The SDK itself is not bundled (operator-licensed wheel); PLC comms live in sylo-plc-comm
